epistemic_policy.R1: Success criteria are defined BEFORE execution
epistemic_policy.R2: Generic AI receives only the raw intent — zero UDX context, supply metadata, or canonical mapping
epistemic_policy.R3: Traditional measurements are labeled REAL or PROXY. PROXY is never merged with REAL in headline scores
epistemic_policy.R4: UDX uses the live production API at https://talentxcel.in/api/udx/resolve
epistemic_policy.R5: ACTION_PROPOSED is never treated as success
epistemic_policy.R6: ACTION_COMPLETED is never treated as VERIFIED_OUTCOME
epistemic_policy.R7: Failures are published with explicit root-cause
epistemic_policy.R8: UDX losses are published — not suppressed or reclassified
epistemic_policy.R10: No composite score until all raw dimensions are published per-objective
epistemic_policy.R11: All results retain source, timestamp, and epistemic_status field
epistemic_policy.R12: Raw JSON and CSV are publicly downloadable

traditional_proxy.note: Aggregate median from NNGroup (2023), Baymard (2023), Google CWV P50 (2024). Excluded from headline comparison per R3.

class_hypothesis.note: The research question: for which classes of objectives does UDX reduce the distance between intent and verified outcome?
